## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

Allowances - Dearness Allowance - Dearness Allowance enhancement of 3.64%
due from 01-01-2024 to the employees of the State Government w.e.f. 01.01.2024 –
Sanctioned – Orders – Issued.

FINANCE (HR.VI-PC&TA) DEPARTMENT

G.O.MS.No. 60

Dated: 20-10-2025

1. G.O.Ms.No.1, Finance (PC-TA) Department, dated 17-01-2022

1. Government also hereby order the revision of Dearness Allowance (DA) rates in respect of State Government employees drawing the Revised UGC Pay Scales, 2006, from 230 % to 239% of the Basic Pay with effect from 01-01-2024.
3. The rates of Dearness Allowance (DA) mentioned at Para 7 above are also applicable to:
5. i. Teaching staff of Government & Aided Affiliated Degree Colleges who are drawing pay in the Revised U.G.C. Pay Scales, 2006.
7. ii. Teaching staff of the Universities including the A.P. Agricultural University, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University and Dr. YSR Horticultural University and the Teaching staff of Govt. Polytechnics who are drawing pay in the Revised UGC/AICTE Pay Scales, 2006.
9. Government also hereby order the revision of Dearness Allowance rates in respect of State Government employees drawing the Revised U.G.C. Pay Scales, 2016 from 46% to 50% of the Basic Pay with effect from 01.01.2024.
11. The rates of Dearness Allowance mentioned at Para 9 above, are also applicable to:
13. i. Teaching staff of Government & Aided Affiliated Degree Colleges who are drawing pay in the Revised U.G.C Pay Scales, 2016.
15. ii. Teaching staff of the Universities including the A.P. Agricultural University, the Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University & the Dr.YSR Horticulture University and the Teaching staff of Govt. Polytechnics who are drawing pay in the Revised UGC / AICTE Pay Scales, 2016.
17. The Dearness Allowance sanctioned in the above paras, shall be paid in cash with salary of October, 2025 payable in November, 2025. The arrears on account of payment of Dearness Allowance for the period from 01-01-2024 to 30-09-2025 shall be payable to the employees at the time of their exit from Government Service.

12. In the event of death of any employee before the issue of these orders, the legal heir(s) shall be entitled to the arrears of Dearness allowance.

13. The term ‘Pay’ for this purpose shall be as defined in FR 9(21)(a)(i).

14. The expenditure on the Dearness Allowance to the employees of Agricultural
Market Committees shall be met from their own funds.

15. All Heads of the Departments and Departments of Secretariat are requested to
issue suitable instructions to the Drawing and Disbursing Officers under their control
and to see that these instructions are followed scrupulously. The Director of Treasuries
and Accounts/ Director of State Audit/ Pay & Accounts Officer/ Director of Works and
Accounts, Andhra Pradesh, Mangalagiri, Guntur are requested to issue suitable
instructions to their subordinate Audit Officers so that these instructions are carefully
followed by them.

16. The CEO, APCFSS is directed to incorporate necessary functionalities in the
payroll system to calculate the DA arrears and generate due drawn statement to
facilitate generation of DA arrears bills bythe Drawing & Disbursing Officers.

17. This order is available in online and can be accessed at http://goir.ap.gov.in
